description: This file defines the CandidateSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams to encapsulate various filtering criteria for candidate searches in the recruitment module of OrangeHRM. It includes properties for candidate IDs, vacancy info, application dates, status, keywords, and other filters, along with getter and setter methods. Additionally, it sets default sorting preferences upon instantiation.

classes.name: CandidateSearchFilterParams
